target_variable.Late_delivery_risk: Binary classification target (1 = Late Delivery, 0 = On-Time / Early / Normal).

critical_leakage_excluded.Days for shipping (real): Direct post-delivery metric. Represents actual days taken to ship and deliver, which is known only after delivery completes.
critical_leakage_excluded.Delivery Status: Direct outcome target variable ('Late delivery', 'Advance shipping', 'Shipping on time', 'Shipping canceled'). Perfectly correlates with Late_delivery_risk.
critical_leakage_excluded.shipping date (DateOrders): Timestamp of physical dispatch/shipment from warehouse. Occurs days after order placement.
critical_leakage_excluded.Order Status: Status of the order post-placement (e.g. COMPLETE, CLOSED, CANCELED, PROCESSING). Status updates occur during and after fulfillment lifecycle.
critical_leakage_excluded.Product Status: Static indicator (100% 0 in dataset) with potential fulfillment-state connotations.

financial_reconciliation_excluded.Order Profit Per Order: Duplicate of benefit per order, known after delivery and reconciliation.
financial_reconciliation_excluded.Order Item Profit Ratio: Derived from actual profit which is post-fulfillment reconciled.

identifiers_and_noise_excluded.Customer Email: PII / Masked string, high cardinality, zero predictive generalization.
identifiers_and_noise_excluded.Customer Street: Freeform address text with extreme noise/cardinality.

retained_order_time_features.Days for shipment (scheduled): Agreed SLA days for shipment decided at order placement.
retained_order_time_features.Shipping Mode: Carrier service level selected by customer at checkout (Standard Class, First Class, Second Class, Same Day).
retained_order_time_features.Type: Payment method chosen at order creation (DEBIT, TRANSFER, PAYMENT, CASH).
retained_order_time_features.Customer Segment: Customer classification at purchase (Consumer, Corporate, Home Office).
retained_order_time_features.Department Name: Store department of ordered item (e.g., Apparel, Fan Shop, Footwear).
retained_order_time_features.Category Name: Product category (e.g., Cleats, Men's Footwear, Fishing).
retained_order_time_features.Sales: Gross sale value (Item Quantity * Product Price).
retained_order_time_features.Market: Global destination market (LATAM, Europe, Pacific Asia, USCA, Africa).
retained_order_time_features.Order Region: Specific geographic destination region (e.g., Western Europe, Central America, Oceania).
retained_order_time_features.order date (DateOrders): Raw order timestamp used to engineer Temporal Features (Month, Day of Week, Hour, Weekend flag, Quarter).
